description: CFD mesh refinement with subcycling in time (G 7 1): the patch takes two steps per step of level 0, the cells around it linear in time; the projection of the patch alone with the pressure of level 0 at its edges (its own flux there), the synchronisation projection over both levels at the end of the level-0 step.
covers: cfd_amr_sub: Berger-Oliger steps, time interpolation of the coarser level, restriction
pr_level: level projection with the coarse pressure at the patch edges (Dirichlet, hydrostatic part as pr_predict)
pr_sync_project: composite correction solve at the end of the level-0 step
